outcome: Loss to follow-up for newborn hearing screening
cohort: 443 NICU infants with extended NICU stay
finding: Younger maternal age, higher gravidity, and former smoking status were independently associated with loss to follow-up for newborn hearing screening.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was not found to be associated with loss to follow-up for newborn hearing screening.
birth_weight: Birth weight was included as a variable but was not found to be associated with loss to follow-up for newborn hearing screening
